title: Loan Desk Guidance: Interest on a Whole Life Insurance Owner Loan Advanced Late in the Interest Period
content:
**Whole Life Insurance — anniversary capitalization of loan interest.**

Within an anniversary capitalization, the latest owner loan advance on the policy ledger, where it falls after the start of the interest period and on or before the anniversary, is set apart from the rest of the principal:

- where it was made **more than 30 calendar days** before the anniversary, it bears interest from its own advance date;
- where it was made **within 30 calendar days** before the anniversary, it bears no interest for the period and is charged from the anniversary onward;
- where the latest owner advance does not fall inside the interest period, nothing is set apart for it and the whole loan principal bears interest from the period start.

When the advance is set apart, the rest of the principal (the ledger principal less that advance) bears interest from the start of the interest period, and the advance bears interest only from the date stated above.

## What counts

- An **owner loan advance** is a loan advanced at the owner's request; an automatic premium loan is not an owner advance.
- Only the **latest** owner advance on the ledger is considered.
- "Inside the interest period" means dated after the period start and on or before the anniversary; an advance dated on the period start itself is not inside it.

## Days before the anniversary (hypothetical anniversary of September 1, 2025)

| Latest owner advance | Days before the anniversary | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| June 3, 2025, 4000.00 | 90 | Set apart; bears interest from June 3, 2025 |
| August 1, 2025 | 31 | Set apart; bears interest from August 1, 2025 |
| August 2, 2025 | 30 | Set apart; bears no interest for the period |
| August 25, 2025 | 7 | Set apart; bears no interest for the period |
| May 10, 2024, with the period starting September 1, 2024 | Before the period | Nothing set apart |

**Illustration.** With a ledger principal of 10000.00 that includes the 4000.00 advanced on June 3, 2025, and a period starting September 1, 2024, 6000.00 bears interest from September 1, 2024 and 4000.00 from June 3, 2025.
